6. Different inorganic salts dissolve in water to
a different extent. Dielectric constant of water
does not change with the change of the solute.
Hence, the correct option is (c).

7. Metallic oxides are basic oxides, and hence,
they react with acid. They form bases when
they react with water.
Hence, the correct option is (d).

8. (a) $2\mathrm{K} + 2\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O} \rightarrow 2\mathrm{KOH} + \mathrm{H}_2$
1 molecule of $\mathrm{K} \rightarrow 1$ molecule of $\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O}$
(b) $3\mathrm{Fe} + 4\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O} \rightarrow \mathrm{Fe}_3\mathrm{O}_4 + 4\mathrm{H}_2$
1 molecule of $\mathrm{Fe} \rightarrow \frac{4}{3} =$ 1.33 molecule of
$\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O}$
(c) $2\mathrm{Al} + 3\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O} \rightarrow \mathrm{Al}_2\mathrm{O}_3 + 3\mathrm{H}_2$
1 molecule of $\mathrm{Al} \rightarrow \frac{3}{2} =$ 1.5 molecule of $\mathrm{Fe}$
$\therefore$ The expected order is c b a.
Hence, the correct option is (d).

9. The order is BAC.
Hence, the correct option is (b).

10. $30 = \frac{x}{(390 - x)} \times 100, x$ is the amount of solute
(B).

$\therefore 390 \times 30 - 30x = 100x$
$\therefore 130x = 390 \times 30$
$\therefore x = \frac{390 \times 30}{130} = 90 \text{ g}$
Hence, the correct option is (a).

13. Solubility of a gas is inversely proportional to
the temperature. Hence, boiling expels the dis-

Hence, the correct option is (a).
